title: Singapore and Penang on Royal Caribbean
alt: Royal Caribbean cruise ship at sea off the Malacca Strait
transport: Private airport and cruise terminal transfers

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: A short sailing with one port call. Three nights, every meal included and a morning ashore in Penang.
expert.tip: Go ashore early at Penang and walk George Town before the heat. The street art and the clan jetties are within twenty minutes of the pier.

summary: Four days at sea from Singapore. Board at the Marina Bay Cruise Centre, a morning ashore in George Town on Penang, a full day at sea, then back into port with all meals included throughout.
included: Included: 3 nights aboard Royal Caribbean with breakfast, lunch and dinner; the Penang port call with time ashore in George Town; private transfers between Changi Airport and the Marina Bay Cruise Centre.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; port charges and gratuities; shore excursions in Penang; speciality restaurants and paid activities on board; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the Marina Bay Cruise Centre
Board your Royal Caribbean ship and find your stateroom
Lunch on board, then the pool deck as Singapore falls away
Optional: the spa, the arcade zone and an outdoor film under the stars
2: Breakfast on board as the ship comes into Penang
Morning ashore in George Town, a short walk from the pier
Street art lanes, the clan jetties and Chulia Street food stalls
Back on board by late afternoon for dinner and the evening show
3: A full day at sea with all meals on board
Optional: wine tasting, salsa classes and the rock climbing wall
Afternoon on the sports court or at the art gallery
Last dinner on board and a show in the main theatre
4: Breakfast on board and disembark at the Marina Bay Cruise Centre
Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

stops.name: Singapore
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast, lunch and dinner included · Stateroom · Royal Caribbean, sailing from the Marina Bay Cruise Centre

program.name: Embarkation day
program.description: Straight from the airport to the cruise terminal, on board by the afternoon and out past the anchorage by evening.

activities.name: Spa at Sea
activities.description: The ship's spa with saunas, a thermal suite and treatment rooms, quietest on the first afternoon.

activities.name: Outdoor Movie Night
activities.description: A screen above the pool deck showing films after dinner, with blankets handed out when it cools.

stops.name: Penang
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast, lunch and dinner included · Stateroom · Royal Caribbean, berthed at Swettenham Pier for the day

program.name: A morning in George Town
program.description: The ship berths at Swettenham Pier, so the old town, the jetties and the street food are within walking distance.

activities.name: Time Ashore in George Town
activities.description: A free morning in the Penang old town, with the street art lanes, the clan jetties and the Chulia Street hawkers.

stops.name: At sea
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast, lunch and dinner included · Stateroom · Royal Caribbean, at sea on the way back to Singapore

program.name: A day at sea and back in
program.description: A full sea day with the decks, the theatre and the dining rooms to yourself, then an early morning arrival in Singapore.

activities.name: Wine Tasting on Board
activities.description: A guided tasting in one of the ship's bars, booked on board and usually held in the late afternoon.

activities.name: Rock Climbing Wall
activities.description: The climbing wall on the upper deck, with harnesses and instructors provided through the day.
